pages.title: Wolverine
pages.text: The $(o)Wolverine$() ($(o)Gulo gulo$()) is the largest land-dwelling member of the weasel family, a stocky, bear-like predator of the northern forests and tundra.$(br2)It is famous for its strength and stamina, covering great distances through deep snow on its broad feet. It hunts small animals and the young of deer and reindeer, and scavenges the kills of wolves and lynx through the winter.$(br2)Its dark coat has a pale stripe along each flank, meeting over the rump.
